text: Expose backlog relationship traversal via query_graph when stub is implemented. Currently BacklogEdge nodes (parent_of, depends_on) are stored in CozoDB but query_graph is a pre-existing stub returning GraphQueryError::Invalid. When query_graph is implemented, backlog edges should be traversable. Source: docs/closure/2026-05-05-002-F-backlog-hydration-closure.md

Add 'backlog' source type to default registry scaffold generated by 'engram install'. Currently the install command creates a registry.yaml without a backlog source entry — users must add it manually. The install command should detect if a .backlogit/ directory exists and offer to add a backlog source. Source: docs/closure/2026-05-05-002-F-backlog-hydration-closure.md

Implement query-graph: replace stub with real graph query execution — query-graph CLI subcommand and MCP tool currently return GraphQueryError::Invalid (stub). Real graph query DSL and execution is future scope. Labels: graph,query,follow-up. Source: docs/closure/2026-05-07-042-F-cli-parity-closure.md

CLI Bug: install/update/reinstall/uninstall commands ignore the --workspace global flag and always use current_dir() instead (src/bin/engram.rs lines 257,266,270,274). Running 'engram install --workspace /path/to/ws' silently installs into the CWD, not the specified workspace. Fix: use flags.resolve_workspace() like all other CLI commands do.

CLI Bug: 'engram sync --direct' and 'engram index --direct' panic with an unhandled CozoDB SQLite BUSY error (exit code 1, thread panic from cozo-0.7.6/src/storage/sqlite.rs:49) when ENGRAM_DATA_DIR is set to a directory whose database is already open by a running daemon. The DaemonLock is acquired successfully, but the DB open task then panics. Should be caught and surfaced as a clean user-facing error: 'workspace database is locked by daemon (PID N); stop the daemon first or use IPC mode (omit --direct)'.

CLI UX: First CLI command that auto-spawns the daemon (e.g. 'engram daemon-status' in a fresh workspace) hangs for 30-60 seconds with no output or progress indication while the daemon initializes (loads embedding model, creates CozoDB, scans workspace). Subsequent commands connect quickly. Fix: add a startup progress indicator or status message ('Starting engram daemon...') so users know the process is not frozen.
